fusions.name: Bodkin at Full Draw
fusions.desc: Looses a narrow-headed shaft up to 9 tiles. It deals 28 damage that ignores armour, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Emptying the Quiver
fusions.desc: Looses 3 shafts in a spread out to 7 tiles. Each shaft deals 6 damage, with a 20% chance to leave its target [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. Holds 5 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Archer's Stakes
fusions.desc: Plants a row of sharpened stakes 5 tiles long in front of you for 10 seconds. The row deals 6 damage to anything that crosses it and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Nocked and Held
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 15 seconds.
